```{r}
MHCNEW$sample <- factor(MHCNEW$sample)
```

```{r}

#Predicting F0 and Pf from Height with covariates
modelMHC1 <- lmer(zF0new ~ Height + Sex + Age + Weight + (1|sample) + (1|Family), data = MHCNEW)
summary(modelMHC1)
modelMHC2 <- lmer(zPfnew ~ Height + Sex + Age + Weight +  (1|sample) + (1|Family), data = MHCNEW)
summary(modelMHC2)

```


```{r}

#Test for model fitness
modelMHC1 <- lmer(
  zF0new ~ Height + Sex + Age + Weight + (1|sample) + (1|Family),
  data = MHCNEW,
  REML = FALSE
)

modelMHC1.fitness <- lmer(
  zF0new ~ Height * Sex + Age + Weight + (1|sample) + (1|Family),
  data = MHCNEW,
  REML = FALSE
)

anova(modelMHC1, modelMHC1.fitness)

```

```{r}
  filter(is.finite(Weight), is.finite(ZMHCTotal), is.finite(zF0new))
```

```{r}
cor_pval <- function(df, vars) {
  results <- list()
  pairs <- combn(vars, 2, simplify = FALSE)
  for (p in pairs) {
    test <- cor.test(df[[p[1]]], df[[p[2]]], use = "complete.obs")
    results[[paste(p[1], "~", p[2])]] <- data.frame(
      var1  = p[1],
      var2  = p[2],
      r     = round(test$estimate, 3),
      p     = round(test$p.value, 4)
    )
  }
  bind_rows(results)
}

vars <- c("zF0new", "ZMHCTotal", "Height", "Weight", "zPfnew")

cat("=== Males ===\n")
print(cor_pval(MHCNEW1_m, vars), row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n=== Females ===\n")
print(cor_pval(MHCNEW1_f, vars), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
MHCNEW1_m_3dplot <- MHCNEW1_m %>%
  filter(!is.na(Weight) & !is.na(ZMHCTotal) & !is.na(zF0new) & !is.na(Age))


MHCNEW1_m_3dplot <- MHCNEW1_m_3dplot %>%
  mutate(
    meanPitch_resid = resid(
      lm(zF0new ~ Height+ Age + sample,
           data = MHCNEW1_m_3dplot)
    )
  )
global_weight_median <- median(MHCNEW1_m_3dplot$Weight, na.rm = TRUE)

MHCNEW1_m_3dplot <- MHCNEW1_m_3dplot %>%
  mutate(
    weight_group = ifelse(Weight >= global_weight_median,
                        "High Weight", "Low Weight"),
    weight_group = factor(weight_group,
                        levels = c("Low Weight", "High Weight"))
  )
MHCNEW1_m_3dplot <- MHCNEW1_m_3dplot %>%
  filter(
    meanPitch_resid > (mean(meanPitch_resid) - 3 * sd(meanPitch_resid)) &
    meanPitch_resid < (mean(meanPitch_resid) + 3 * sd(meanPitch_resid))
  )


p_global_split <- ggplot(MHCNEW1_m_3dplot, aes(x = ZMHCTotal, y = meanPitch_resid, color = weight_group)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  labs(
    x = "Testostrone (Log Transformed)
    Males",
    y = "Fundamental Frequency (Resid.)",
    color = "Weight levels" 
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  facet_wrap(~ weight_group, scales = "free_x") +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 15),  
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 15), 
  strip.text = element_text(size = 14))

print(p_global_split)
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
MHCNEW1_m_3dplot <- MHCNEW1_m %>%
  filter(is.finite(Weight), is.finite(ZMHCTotal), is.finite(zF0new))

modelMHC1_m1.3dplot2 <- lm(
  scale(zF0new) ~ scale(ZMHCTotal) * scale(Weight) + Age,
  data = MHCNEW1_m_3dplot
)


h_min2 <- min(MHCNEW1_m_3dplot$Weight, na.rm = TRUE)
h_max2 <- max(MHCNEW1_m_3dplot$Weight, na.rm = TRUE)
mhc_min2 <- min(MHCNEW1_m_3dplot$ZMHCTotal, na.rm = TRUE)
mhc_max2 <- max(MHCNEW1_m_3dplot$ZMHCTotal, na.rm = TRUE)

h_range2 <- seq(h_min2, h_max2, length.out = 50)
mhc_range2 <- seq(mhc_min2, mhc_max2, length.out = 50)


predict_grid2_mhc <- expand_grid(ZMHCTotal = mhc_range2, Weight = h_range2) %>%
  mutate(Age = mean(MHCNEW1_m_3dplot$Age, na.rm = TRUE)) 


predict_grid2_mhc$Predicted_zPfnew <- predict(
  modelMHC1_m1.3dplot2,
  newdata = predict_grid2_mhc,
  re.form = NA
)


Z_matrix2 <- predict_grid2_mhc %>%

    filter(is.finite(Predicted_zPfnew)) %>%
  
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = ZMHCTotal,
    names_from = Weight,
    values_from = Predicted_zPfnew
  ) %>%

  select(-ZMHCTotal) %>%

  as.matrix()

x_range <- range(h_range2)
y_range <- range(mhc_range2)
z_range <- range(Z_matrix2, na.rm = TRUE)
                 
                 
p <- plot_ly(
  x = h_range2, 
  y = mhc_range2, 
  z = Z_matrix2, 
  type = "surface",
  showscale = FALSE, 
  colorscale = list(
    c(0, "#0a9396"),    
    c(0.69, "#ffba08"),

  contours = list(
    x = list(show = TRUE, color = "white", width = 1),

) 

# Bottom face
p <- p %>% add_trace(x = c(x_range[1], x_range[2]), y = c(y_range[1], y_range[1]), z = c(z_range[1], z_range[1]),
```

```{r}
summary_stats0 <- MHCNEW %>%

  )

summary_stats <- MHCNEW %>%  
  group_by(sample, Sex) %>%  
  summarise(   
    
    mean_zPfnew = mean(zPfnew, na.rm = TRUE),  
    sd_zPfnew = sd(zPfnew, na.rm = TRUE),  
    max_zPfnew = max(zPfnew, na.rm = TRUE),  
    min_zPfnew = min(zPfnew, na.rm = TRUE)  
  )  

print(summary_stats, n = Inf)


summary_stats1 <- MHCNEW %>%
  group_by(sample, Sex) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      c(f1new, f2new, f3new, f4new),
      list(
        mean = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd   = ~sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        max  = ~max(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        min  = ~min(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(summary_stats1, n = Inf)
```

#### Anlysis after exluding one person from each sibling pair (N=57)


```{r, include=FALSE}
MHCNEW.excluded <- read_excel("../data/MHCdata-final2.xlsx", sheet = "After exclusions")

```



```{r}
MHCNEW.excluded <- MHCNEW.excluded %>%  
  rename(Sex = Sex1male2female)

MHCNEW.excluded <- MHCNEW.excluded %>%  
  rename(sample = Collaborators)
MHCNEW.excluded <- MHCNEW.excluded %>%  
  rename(Height = Height_cm) 
MHCNEW.excluded <- MHCNEW.excluded %>%  
  rename(Weight = Weight_kg)


str(MHCNEW.excluded)
```

```{r}



MHCNEW.excluded$Height <- scale(MHCNEW.excluded$Height)


MHCNEW.excluded$zPfnew <- (scale(MHCNEW.excluded$f1new) + scale(MHCNEW.excluded$f2new) + scale(MHCNEW.excluded$f3new) + scale(MHCNEW.excluded$f4new))/4
MHCNEW.excluded$zF0new <- scale(MHCNEW.excluded$zF0new)
MHCNEW.excluded$Weight <- scale(MHCNEW.excluded$Weight)

MHCNEW.excluded$Sex <- as.factor(MHCNEW.excluded$Sex)
```


```{r}

modelMHCNEW.excluded1 <- lmer(zF0new ~ Height + Sex + Age + Weight + (1|sample), data = MHCNEW.excluded)
summary(modelMHCNEW.excluded1)
modelMHCNEW.excluded2 <- lmer(zPfnew ~ Height + Sex + Age + Weight + (1|sample), data = MHCNEW.excluded)
summary(modelMHCNEW.excluded2)

```


```{r}

modelMHCNEW.excluded3 <- lmer(Height ~ ZMHCTotal + Sex + Age + Weight + (1|sample), data = MHCNEW.excluded)
summary(modelMHCNEW.excluded3)


```

```{r}

modelMHCNEW.excluded4 <- lmer(zF0new ~ ZMHCTotal + Height + Sex + Age + Weight + (1|sample), data = MHCNEW.excluded)
summary(modelMHCNEW.excluded4)
modelMHCNEW.excluded5 <- lmer(zPfnew ~ ZMHCTotal + Height + Sex + Age + Weight + (1|sample), data = MHCNEW.excluded)
summary(modelMHCNEW.excluded5)

```

```{r}

MHCNEW.excluded_m <- MHCNEW.excluded %>% filter(Sex == 1)
MHCNEW.excluded_f <- MHCNEW.excluded %>% filter(Sex == 2)

modelMHCNEW.excluded1_m1 <- lmer(zF0new ~ ZMHCTotal*(Weight) +Height + Age +(1|sample), data = MHCNEW.excluded_m)
summary(modelMHCNEW.excluded1_m1)
modelMHCNEW.excluded2_m1 <- lmer(zPfnew ~ ZMHCTotal *(Weight) +Height + Age +(1|sample), data = MHCNEW.excluded_m)
summary(modelMHCNEW.excluded2_m1)
```
